capabilities: Visualize the vault as nested squares where each folder is a square and each note is a dot
Zoom into a single folder square to show note names, link lines and previews
Preview a note's name, folder, link counts and first lines by hovering its dot
Search note and folder names from any level and jump to matches
Open notes by clicking dots, or directly with Shift/Ctrl+click inside closed squares
extras: Search only matches note and folder names, not note text; link lines are drawn only within the square being viewed; on mobile, tapping works but pinch-to-zoom is not supported yet. The plugin writes only its own data.json and does not modify notes.
intentEvidence: I made this because Obsidian's graph got slow and messy once my vault grew past a thousand notes.
motivation: The author built it because Obsidian's graph got slow and messy once their vault grew past a thousand notes.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph becomes slow and cluttered once a vault grows past a thousand notes.
summary: Vault graph that shows folders as squares and notes as dots, letting you zoom into one folder at a time so large vaults stay fast.
